messages:
sam: heads-up — vendor dropped a new checkpoint (velvet-13b). Request: onboarding intake + quantization probe plan. goal: 2.5x cost reduction vs fp32 with <=1.5 pts ppl regress on our chat eval. who can own quick matrix and infra?
maya: putting this on my radar. can you paste expected seq len distribution and baseline ppl numbers? that drives int8 vs fp8 tradeoffs.
sam: baseline ppl on our 500-chat probe is 18.4 (fp32). token lengths skew 50–400, median ~120. we need to prioritize tail latency for 99p.
chris: suggestion: run a compact probe matrix (fast) then expand winners. row-major: [fp32 baseline, int8-symmetric, int8-affine, fp8-e4m3, gguf-int8 (ggml export)]. metrics: ppl, chat-turn F1, embedding cosine to fp32, and token-level decode anomalies (bad eos). pass thresholds: ppl delta <= +1.5, embedding cosine >= 0.985, chat-turn F1 drop <= 2%.
ellie: +1. also include a small safety/regression set (50 prompts) and a hallucination checklist. run each config with three seeds for stability.
chris: quick probe plan (short):
```
# probe grid (fast)
configs = [
  {"name":"fp32"},
  {"name":"int8-affine","calib":"minmax","perchannel":true},
  {"name":"int8-symmetric","calib":"movingavg"},
  {"name":"fp8-e4m3","calib":"dynamic"},
  {"name":"gguf-int8","backend":"ggml"}
]
# eval harness flags
--dataset velvet_probe_250.jsonl --max-tokens 512 --samples-per-config 250
```
maya: for infra, prefer A100-80GB for fp32 baseline and L4s for int8/fp8 probes if possible (cost save). need 2 A100s for parallel baseline runs.
infra-bot: infra ticket created: INFRA-4821 — request: 2x A100-80GB (3 days), 4x L4 (2 days). owner: mike.
mike: ack, I'll scope. ETA to provision within 48h if no conflicts.
ellie: eval commands (example):
```
python eval/run_eval.py --model velvet-13b --quant int8-affine --calib-config calib.yaml --dataset velvet_probe_250.jsonl --seed 42 --out results/int8-affine.json
```
include flag `--kv-cache partitioned` for long-context runs.
chris: calibration notes: collect calibration traces across 2k samples, prioritize high-token prompts (>=200) to capture KV cache scaling. if int8 drift looks high, try per-channel vs per-tensor and symmetric vs affine.
sam: owner matrix: maya (priority/analysis), chris (quant configs), ellie (eval harness & prompts), mike (infra). target: fast probe results in 5 working days, deep calibration in 2 weeks.
quant-bot: summary: plan queued: 5 configs x 3 seeds x 250 samples => ~3750 evals. est tokens ~1.2M. estimated cost: ~0.9 A100-days if parallelized.
maya: also propose a quick automatic gating rule: if embedding cosine < 0.98 OR ppl delta > +2.0 -> deprioritize and mark for hybrid fallback (keep fp32/Dedicated route).
ellie: please add a smoke test snippet for regression alerts:
```
# smoke check pseudocode
if results['ppl_delta'] > 1.5 or results['embedding_cosine'] < 0.985:
  post_to_channel('#eng-ml', "velvet-13b: quant fail on {config}; see results")
```
sam: noted. maya — can you add the eval prompt list (250) to the intake doc? link to sample set: https://internal-storage/velvet_probe_250.jsonl
maya: will do. also adding a small fairness pass (10 prompts) to the pipeline.
chris: config blob for int8-affine calibration (quick):
```
{
  "quant_type": "int8",
  "scheme": "affine",
  "per_channel": true,
  "clip_method": "percentile",
  "percentile": 99.99
}
```
adjust percentile if activation tails dominate.
ellie: reminder: export gguf with metadata tags: model.hash, calib.method, eval.timestamp. helps trace regressions.
mike: infra note: if runtime memory for gguf exports exceeds L4 capacity, switch to A10x or use batch_size 1 decode. I'll add fallback rules in INFRA-4821.
sam: risk log quick: 1) large ppl regression on chat prompts, 2) KV-cache blowups at seq>512, 3) quantization artifacting on code generation. mitigation: gating thresholds + canary route on Dedicated with warm cache.
quant-bot: action items auto-filled:
- maya: upload eval sets + baseline logs (due in 24h)
- chris: generate calib configs and run local synth traces (48h)
- ellie: add smoke/regression hooks to harness (48h)
- mike: confirm infra provisioning (48h)
- sam: triage and sync with product for target SLOs (72h)
:rocket:
maya: will start nightly probes once infra is green. will post incremental results in this thread.
sam: thanks all — looping in @eng-ml for visibility. :eyes:
